slogan.zh: OB开源 Agent 记忆及上下文引擎

promotion.zh: 已支持DSH，欢迎 star！跨会话记忆、上下文复用、按需召回
promotion.en: Supports DSH — star us! Cross-session memory, context reuse, and on-demand recall.

tooltip.zh: 特别感谢 PowerContext，为 Agent 提供开源的长期记忆与上下文管理能力。将项目决策、任务进展与历史经验保存为长期记忆，跨会话、跨 Agent 按需召回，减少重复解释和探索，让任务持续推进，让 token 花得更省。在公开测试集 SWE-bench Pro 上实测使用powercontext 累计输入 token 减少约 25%，高消耗长尾任务的单题输入 token 峰值下降超 75%。
tooltip.en: Special thanks to PowerContext for providing open-source long-term memory and context management for AI agents. Preserve project decisions, task progress, and lessons learned, then recall relevant context on demand across sessions and agents. Reduce repeated explanations and exploration, keep tasks moving, and use tokens more efficiently. In tests on the public SWE-bench Pro dataset, PowerContext reduced cumulative input tokens by approximately 25% and peak per-task input tokens for high-consumption, long-tail tasks by over 75%.
